Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Strategy cadence: planning scaffold & tradeoff calendar

Team —

Kickoff for FY29 planning: attached is a first-pass planning scaffold (planning-scaffold-v1.pdf) and a proposed decision calendar. The aim here is to get a lightweight, clearly-owned cadence so we can close targets and key tradeoffs by Oct 2. High-level ask: review the scaffold and the calendar and reply with (A) gaps/obvious misses, (B) decision owners we should assign now, and (C) any red lines from a capacity / hiring / financial perspective.

Quick summary of the scaffold:
- Timeline: Aug 16 -> Oct 02 (two working months)
- Milestones: baseline targets (by Aug 30), scenario modeling (by Sep 13), leadership review + tradeoffs (Sep 20–24), final signoff & budget submission (by Oct 02)
- Decision calendar: weekday slots reserved for tradeoff reviews (blocks on calendar attached as decision-calendar-draft.ics)
- Owners: R&D (Laura), GTM demand/ops (Marissa), Platform infra/costs (Markus), Exec approvals & cross-org escalation (Vivek)

A few specific asks to make replies short and actionable:
1) Laura — can you confirm we can have a targets baseline (historical removal, growth assumptions) by Aug 30? If you need a model template I can share ours.
2) Marissa — please confirm whether the demand model assumptions you need are in the Drive link; if not, sketch missing inputs you need by EOD Thu.
3) Markus — list any hard infra constraints (capacity, renewal timing, licensing) that could create non-negotiable tradeoffs.
4) Vivek — confirm whether the suggested Sep 20 leadership review window works for the exec calendar or if you want to shift earlier.

Attachments: planning-scaffold-v1.pdf (scaffold + calendar), decision-calendar-draft.ics

Thanks — short replies appreciated so we can iterate quickly.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP, Strategy & Operations
Redwood Inference

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear framework. Quick answers:
- Baseline by Aug 30: yes, we can deliver a baseline targets sheet. I'll use the historical removal approach you suggested and call out the FY28 overhang.
- Gap: we need a simple sensitivity column for churn and ARR-to-usage conversion (if you can add that to the scaffold that would speed things up).
- Owner confirmation: happy to own baseline targets.

I'll attach a short note with the baseline fields I intend to populate. Expect a first draft by Aug 28.

— Laura

Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategy cadence: planning scaffold & tradeoff calendar

Jonas / team —

A few infra-side constraints to flag early (so they show up in the tradeoff discussion):
- GPU renewal window: a refresh/renewal decision for our pod contracts hits Sep 15–20. If we plan for large capacity increases before that window we risk procurement delays.
- Quantization & latency experiments: a 3–4 week runway is required to validate any new quantization switches at production scale. That pushes decisions earlier (ideally Sep 1).
- Cost levers: batching and cache TTL changes can shave marginal unit cost quickly, but large savings require model swaps or new hardware — those require tradeoff signoff.

Suggested immediate asks for the group: list any +1 resource requests (headcount or infra) by Aug 24 and mark whether they are critical vs. desirables. I will compile into the infra red-lines doc.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
